$comment: Authoritative allocation registry for supabase/migrations numeric prefixes. Consumed by tools/scripts/check-migration-prefixes.mjs. To add a NEW migration you must FIRST reserve its number here in its own reviewed change; the guard fails any migration whose number is not listed. See docs/ci/migration-prefix-guard.md and docs/migrations/migration-ledger.md.

022.note: Three open PRs each introduced a different 022_* migration (search index, email log, listing expiry). The founder must assign 022 to exactly ONE lane; the other two must renumber before merge. See docs/migrations/migration-ledger.md.

024.note: Reserved for Lane B. Unused by this PR; present so the guard recognizes a future 024_* migration owned by this lane.

027.note: P0 #1 - column-level SELECT lockdown for the anon role on public.host_profiles; adds the column dimension the row-level host_profiles_select_public policy (migration 013) cannot express. Authored review-only; founder-operated prod apply. See docs/runbooks/security-host-profile-anon-columns.md.

028.note: Adds reports table with RLS for the seeker moderation flow (issue #47). REVIEW-ONLY — not applied to any live database.

029.note: Adds listing_boost_campaigns and employer_featured_campaigns tables with tier-ranked RLS for homepage paid placement. REVIEW-ONLY — not applied to any live database.

030.note: Adds seeker_badges table with badge_key/awarded_at/metadata. REVIEW-ONLY — not applied to any live database.

031.note: Two open PRs each introduced a different 031_* migration (community_phase2, seeker_profile_photo_url). The founder must assign 031 to exactly ONE lane; the other must renumber before merge.

032.note: Extends seeker_profiles (seeking_timeline, general_skill_tags), seeker_resume_experiences (location), seeker_resume_educations (location, is_current), seeker_certifications (skill_tags, does_not_expire, description) for the 5-step resume builder. REVIEW-ONLY — not applied to any live database.
